explanation: By the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation, $pH = pK_a + \log([\text{Salt}]/[\text{Acid}])$. When $[\text{Salt}] = [\text{Acid}]$, $\log(1) = 0$, so $pH = pK_a$. This is the half-equivalence point condition.
